units.title: Level One · The Lines
units.epigraph: for anyone, in one sitting

units.title: Level Two · The Manual
units.epigraph: for the one who will practise

units.title: Part I · The Ground
units.epigraph: what is

units.title: The Three and the Zero
units.epigraph: A binary with a waiting room is still a binary.

units.title: The Given
units.epigraph: The ground does not negotiate. That is not its cruelty. That is its honesty.

units.title: Attention
units.epigraph: You have exactly as much life as you have attention.

units.title: Witness
units.epigraph: To be seen is not vanity. It is ontology.

units.title: Part II · The Practice
units.epigraph: how to stand

units.title: Name the Binary
units.epigraph: A binary you can see is no longer doing its job.

units.title: Construct the Third
units.epigraph: The third is built, never selected.

units.title: Own the Ground
units.epigraph: Insight without position is a discovery made on someone else’s behalf.

units.title: Keep the Middle
units.epigraph: The zero is not the place you escape to. It is the place you return from.

units.title: Refuse the Waiting Room
units.epigraph: A decision deferred so long it became the architecture was never deferred. It was made — by default, in secret, against you.

units.title: Part III · The Weight
units.epigraph: what it costs

units.title: The Asymmetry
units.epigraph: Seeing the third is cheap and feels like enormous progress. Holding it costs years. Budget for the expensive half or do not begin.

units.title: Continuity
units.epigraph: You are not the same person you were. You are also not a different one. Both facts are load-bearing, and confusing them is how lives break.

units.title: The Losable Claim
units.epigraph: A claim that cannot lose cannot win. This applies to physics. It applies to you.

units.title: Part IV · The Care
units.epigraph: what it is for

units.title: Empathy as Catalyst
units.epigraph: Empathy opens a door. It is not a force. What walks through the door is a different thing entirely, and it must be judged on its own.

units.title: The Inviolate
units.epigraph: Another person’s middle is not yours. Not even to help. Not even to love. Especially not to love.

units.title: The Long Reclamation
units.epigraph: The spark has never been destroyed. It has been buried. And the desire to find the spark is the spark itself, flickering.

units.title: Level Three · The Degree
units.epigraph: for the one who has stopped rounding

units.title: The Degree
units.epigraph: Most of what is true of you is true to a degree. The either/or rounds it off.

units.title: The Weakest Link
units.epigraph: When two things must both be true, the lower one is your answer.

units.title: Act Crisp
units.epigraph: Weigh in degrees. Move in one piece.

units.title: Level Four · The Principle
units.epigraph: for the one who asks why

units.title: Existence Is Sufficient
units.epigraph: Nothing gives legitimacy to existence except existence itself.

units.title: Three Relationships, Not Three Requirements
units.epigraph: Existence is unconditional. Consciousness is an opportunity. Connection is a choice.

units.title: Change Without Erasure
units.epigraph: Change without erasure. Understanding without possession.

units.title: Dignity Is Owed, Respect Is Earned
units.epigraph: Dignity is the floor. Respect is the ceiling.

units.title: Level Five · The Proof and Its Limits
units.epigraph: for the one who checks

units.title: Part III — The Third State and Consequence (§12–§17)
The Program, Preregistered
units.epigraph: Small enough to calculate and precise enough to lose.

units.title: What the Axiom Does Not Prove
units.epigraph: Existence legitimizes. It does not calculate.

units.title: Beyond Logic
units.epigraph: What can be proved has been proved. What remains is what was always first.

units.title: Colophon
units.epigraph: Twenty-five chapters. Five levels. One stance.
units.kicker: The Geometry of Existence: a Manual for Life

figures.caption: Four middles. The unknown waits to become one of two. The degree sits on the line. The zero is where you stand to see the line. The third is off the line.
Nine-tenths and two-tenths, combined four ways. Three are forms of “and.” The fourth is an average, which lets the strong score pay for the weak one.
Several partial truths, each held to its own degree, resolve into a single setting. The weighing is graded. The output is not.
The floor is level and holds everyone. The ceiling is raised by conduct, one course at a time.
The simplex of three-state distributions. A third state adds a coordinate to the space of probabilities, not a dimension to physical space.
Zero-state probability for the centre spin at βJ = βD = ln 2. Past the threshold, aligned neighbours favour the zero state more than opposed ones do. Model values, not measurements.
The number the consequence model must get right, at βχ = ln 2 with all other couplings off. Model values, not measurements.
Two graphs with six sites, nine edges and degree three throughout. Exhaustive enumeration of all 729 states of each, at Δ/J = 3/4 and βJ = 3.
The 240 roots of E₈ projected to the Coxeter plane: eight rings of thirty. Computed from the root system for this edition. A fact of geometry, not of spacetime.
Zero-site occupancy on the two graphs: exact prediction beside the simulated dry run. A dry run tests the procedure. It is not a measurement.
The record under the frozen retention ρ = 0.9. However long the zero state is held, the record cannot exceed 1/(1 − ρ) = 10.
